listing.name: Quake 4 (Xbox 360 edition) (Xbox 360 Quake 4 decomp/recomp)
listing.summary: Attach the prepared Xbox 360 Quake 4 Windows native-renderer player, preserving its exact game location and q4 data root. This is separate from PC openQ4 and the legacy runtime; upstream owns local generation and replacement.

steps.title: Prepare your own Xbox 360 Quake 4 files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 Quake 4 ISO, or complete matching extracted files including default.xex and the game’s PK4 data. PC Quake 4/openQ4 files are not interchangeable. Complete the supported upstream setup/build and original selection before attachment. The selected v0.2.0 source documents ReXGlue SDK v0.10.0 plus this title’s patches, generation from the owner’s XEX and a completed Windows native player; the observed setup EXE is a preparation program, not the locally generated game.

steps.title: Keep the actual completed native-renderer unit
steps.instruction: Use the completed q4hle.exe from the upstream player or documented Q4_HLE-enabled build, retaining all matching runtime/rendering DLLs, settings/resources and original files. Its selected Q4HleApp is the normal q4 application with a title-specific native Direct3D 11 renderer; the SDK/Xenos q4.exe and legacy-runtime builds are distinct variants, not interchangeable qualification. Do not register Quake4-Setup-0.2.0.exe, a compiler, profiler or renderer-shadow test as normal Play.

steps.title: Attach the in-process game
steps.instruction: Select the completed q4hle.exe, use its complete player/build-output directory as working directory and leave arguments empty after upstream original/settings preparation. Review the exact intent and request Play separately. The native entry inherits the q4 application’s ordinary path selection and runtime loop; it remembers the existing game location in q4.toml and can request a valid own ISO or extracted default.xex when missing. Finish those prompts upstream before retrying. Keep Q4_HLE_NATIVE/shadow/debug choices at the installation’s intended ordinary settings and close the actual game normally.

steps.title: Preserve q4 settings, original location and user data
steps.instruction: Keep q4.toml beside the executable, the original ISO or complete extracted game tree at its configured location, and the full active user/cache/data roots. The pinned SDK’s Windows default user root is Known Documents/q4, including relocated Documents folders; existing user_data_root/cache_root flags or configuration override it. This title’s inspected SDK patch allows an ISO file as game_data_root and does not replace that user-root selection. Preserve saves, profile/settings, caches, logs, historical variants and recovery separately; do not merge legacy, PC openQ4 and Xbox-runtime saves or create a fresh replacement root.

steps.title: Keep renderer, compatibility and maintenance limits
steps.instruction: Retain title, patched ReXGlue SDK, compiler, shader/audio/library and all other component notices, separately from the original game. The initial-level/menu observations and native-renderer claims are upstream evidence, not full campaign, physical-controller or real-save restore qualification here. Upstream/player owns preparation and replacement: quit normally, preserve data/recovery and review/relink changed bytes after updates. This existing-player route grants no source/distribution rights and supplies no Portcove managed install/update/backup/rollback/migration/external deletion.

warnings: Select the actual completed q4hle.exe and preserve q4.toml, the original location and existing q4 data root. PC openQ4, the SDK renderer and legacy builds have separate compatibility and maintenance scope.
